data.exact_reserve_text: The 2020 year of account is currently forecasting a breakeven return on capacity, which is predominantly due to prudent reserving.
data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the start of the year (1 Jan 2021) were GBP 19.043m and the gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2021 were GBP 14.774m, representing an overall reduction in gross reserves during 2021. The report references prudent reserving for closed years, sensitivity to COVID-19, climate change, US legislation and Brexit, and notes reinsurance programme activity. The report does not disclose an explicit gross prior-year development (PYD) figure for prior underwriting years.
raw_causal_phrases: The recent tragic invasion of Ukraine which has sparked war in Eastern Europe is an ongoing reminder of the complexities the syndicate faces when navigating risk.

Estimates which are sensitive to changes in future economic conditions could be impacted by significant changes in the economic and regulatory environment, such as COVID-19, climate change, US legislation and Brexit.
The most critical estimate included within the syndicate's balance sheet is the estimate for insurance losses incurred but not reported ('IBNR')
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year development (PYD) figure for prior underwriting years is provided in the report. The technical note contains a 'movement in the provision' (gross movement in claims during the year of -4,411.5k) but that line represents the total change in the provision for the year (including current year activity) and per instructions was not used to derive PYD. A gross claims development triangle is present (percentages and summary GBP GBP ms), but the report does not provide the prior-diagonal absolute gross ultimate estimates in monetary terms for each underwriting year to compute a definitive gross PYD. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null.
